patronOf.en-US: Patron of fishermen and the papacy
patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro dos pescadores e do papado

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Senhor, tu sabes tudo; tu sabes que eu te amo.

meta.face: An elderly man, around 65, broad and weathered fisherman's face, curly grey-white hair balding from the back of the head with a curly tuft left at the forehead, a short square curly grey-white beard, strong wide nose, deep-set earnest eyes, lined forehead.
meta.basis: Curly hair and a short square beard since the 4th century; balding with a forelock tuft from the second millennium.

sources.title: Christ between Peter and Paul, 4th-c. catacomb painting

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
